ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen if all the platypus were removed?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. The platypus is located at the top of the food web; in the diagram there are arrows from organisms below pointing to the platypus, including an arrow from the node labeled “dragonfly larvae” pointing to the platypus, indicating that the platypus will eat dragonfly larvae. Reasoning: If all platypus are removed, dragonfly larvae will experience less predation pressure. According to the rule that after predators are removed, the number of their prey usually increases, dragonfly larvae will become more numerous.
